parameters.name: commodity_set_size
parameters.description: Number of commodities in the commodity set \(\mathcal{I}\)

parameters.name: imported_input_expenditure_coefficients
parameters.description: Imported-input expenditure coefficient for each commodity

parameters.name: technical_input_matrix
parameters.description: Technical input matrix where \(a_{ij}\) is the amount of commodity \(j\) required per unit of commodity \(i\)

parameters.name: production_upper_bounds
parameters.description: Optional production capacity upper bound for each commodity

parameters.name: demand_caps
parameters.description: Optional external demand cap for each commodity

parameters.name: total_available_labor
parameters.description: Total labor available over the planning horizon

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Production and export quantity for each commodity

variables.name: optimal_objective_value
variables.description: Optimal objective value of the planning problem

constraints.name: production_nonnegativity
constraints.description: production and export quantities must be nonnegative for all commodities

constraints.name: scalar_output_nonnegativity
constraints.description: the reported objective value and imported-input expenditure are real-valued scalars, with imported-input expenditure nonnegative

constraints.name: labor_capacity_limit
constraints.description: total labor used across all commodities may not exceed the available labor

constraints.name: production_capacity_limit
constraints.description: if a production upper bound is provided, production of a commodity cannot exceed that bound

constraints.name: demand_cap_limit
constraints.description: if a demand cap is provided, exported quantity of a commodity cannot exceed that cap

constraints.name: same_period_sale_or_export
constraints.description: all produced quantities are sold or exported within the same period

constraints.name: production_nonnegativity
constraints.description: production and export quantities must be nonnegative for all commodities

constraints.name: scalar_output_nonnegativity
constraints.description: the reported objective value is unrestricted and imported-input expenditure is nonnegative

constraints.name: optimal_objective_definition
constraints.description: the reported objective value equals the total export revenue from the production plan

constraints.name: parameter_nonnegativity
constraints.description: export prices, imported-input expenditure coefficients, labor requirements, total labor, and any optional capacity or demand caps are nonnegative

constraints.name: technical_coefficient_nonnegativity
constraints.description: technical input coefficients must be nonnegative for all commodity pairs

constraints.name: production_continuous_domain
constraints.description: production quantities are continuous and nonnegative

constraints.name: single_period_indexing
constraints.description: the model is indexed to a single planning period and has no inter-period carryover state

constraints.name: imported_input_expenditure_definition
constraints.description: the imported-input expenditure equals the coefficient-weighted expenditure implied by the production plan

constraints.name: reporting_variable_definition
constraints.description: the scalar report variable z records total export value and m records total imported-input expenditure

objectives.name: maximize_export_value
objectives.description: maximize total export value across all commodities

final_objective.description: Lexicographically maximize total export revenue and, among all export-optimal plans, minimize total imported-input expenditure.
